name: music-mirror
description: Private YouTube Music listening analytics from an Android collector.

interface.shortDescription: Understand your mobile YouTube Music habits.
interface.longDescription: Music Mirror privately records YouTube Music playback on Android and lets ChatGPT analyze recent listens, favorite tracks, completion rates, and listening patterns.
